notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.content:
-fixed some specific sounds not being changeable (by volume settings slider)
-level editor now automatically removes wrong tiles/fragments
-fixed Eurasia (map) not having any grass
...and other minor changes

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content:
-hotkey to select unmoved units now makes the same sound as the icon-button
-unlimited round time by sliding the time-slider to the right (with STATIC instead of DYNAMIC time)
-default-mode: bot/player loses when no tiles left (excluding water or mountain tiles)
-VR: units now grab-able with hands/swords (better to zoom out fully by dragging both hands out before)

notes.title: First Patch | v1.0.3
notes.content:
-New Maps/Levels: Globus, Americas, Afrique, Eurasia
-Highlight where (and if) a unit can move when selected
-easy AI became easier (no more spamming on buildings)
-normal AI spawns fewer units out of nowhere
-VR Vive Input fixes
-Some VR movement and input improvements
-Tutorial UI less in the way
-Tutorial last step better explanation
-Hotkey to select unmoved units fixed (selected all but 1 before)
-Some other minor improvements and fixes...
